Generated by WorkTrack3D (Pivot Stage 4 task: K2 Plus OrcaSlicer profiles, fixed 2026-05-27 for OrcaSlicer 2.3.x CLI compatibility). Provenance: CLAUDE.md USER CONTEXT TARGET MACHINES sec.1 (K2 Plus hardware spec); src/shared/k2-plus-slice-presets.ts K2_PLUS_HARDWARE_CEILINGS (upper bound for every speed/accel/temp -- nothing below may exceed those); resources/machines/creality-k2-plus.json (WorkTrack3D machine row). OrcaSlicer 2.3.x canonical reference: SoftFever/OrcaSlicer @ resources/profiles/Creality/machine/Creality K2 Plus 0.4 nozzle.json -- this profile is a self-contained variant of the same (no `inherits` resolution because Orca CLI does not always resolve user-side inheritance correctly). Safety Rule 1: machine_max_* ceilings below cap the machine envelope; per-profile process speeds stay STRICTLY UNDER these (see process/standard.json and high_speed.json).
